title: Independent-critic Gauntlet loop and prompts
what_it_does: Rules (builder is never the judge, fresh critic per round, ledger) plus ready critic prompts for a component, a full film, a verification round and a storyboard, each demanding timestamped, ranked defects.
when_to_use: Quality gate on a finished explainer, run by a clean-context agent.
why: Directly usable (HyperFrames-aware, renderer-agnostic), MIT. Matches how Kerem already runs denetci. Strip the business-offer parts.
